text: The MMR vaccine has been proven to cause autism in children.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: The MMR vaccines have been proven to cause autism in children
room.note: 4% definitely true, 20% probably true, 43% probably false, 32% definitely false. Annenberg’s April 2024 survey found the same 24%.

truthSource.label: CDC, Autism and Vaccines
truthSource.oneLine: Studies of millions of children find no link between the MMR vaccine and autism; the 1998 paper that claimed one was retracted.

lesson.tip: A single retracted 1998 paper still circulates. When a claim cites “a study,” check whether it was retracted and what larger studies found.
